title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid and complete registration information.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page at /auth
Enter valid user details including email, password, and required profile info
Submit the registration form
Verify account creation success message and redirection to login or dashboard

title: User Registration with Missing Mandatory Fields
description: Validate error handling when user submits registration without mandatory fields.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page at /auth
Submit the registration form leaving mandatory fields empty
Verify appropriate error messages are shown indicating missing required fields

title: Login Success with Correct Credentials
description: Check login is successful when entering valid username/email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page at /auth
Input correct username/email and password
Click login button
Verify that the user is authenticated and redirected to main dashboard

title: Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Ensure login failure when invalid username/email or password is entered.

steps.description: Navigate to login page at /auth
Input incorrect username/email or password
Click login button
Verify that login is denied and an error message is displayed

title: Optional MFA Setup during Login
description: Verify that users can successfully enable and use multi-factor authentication during login.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials
Opt to enable MFA from security settings
Complete MFA setup process
Log out and attempt login with MFA enabled
Enter username and password
When prompted, enter valid MFA code
Verify successful login after correct MFA code input

title: Access Demo Mode Without Credentials
description: Verify that users can enter the demo mode seamlessly without providing real credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to /demo page
Start demo experience using provided demo profiles and AppFactory
Verify access to demo functionalities without requiring login
Verify no real user credentials are requested or stored

title: Discover Profiles and Like Functionality
description: Validate users can discover profiles, send likes, and that the UI updates accordingly.

steps.description: Login successfully and navigate to /discover
Browse profile cards and select a profile to view details
Click 'like' on a profile
Verify UI reflects the like action and profile status updates accordingly

title: Matches Synchronization After Mutual Likes
description: Ensure matches are properly created and reflected when two users like each other.

steps.description: User A likes User B from /discover
User B likes User A
Both users navigate to /matches
Verify that the match appears in both users' matches lists

title: Access Chat Only After Match Established
description: Validate that users can only initiate or access real-time chat after having a match.

steps.description: Login as User without a match
Attempt to access /chat or chat with a non-matched user
Verify access is denied or redirected with a proper message
Login as User with an existing match
Access chat with the matched profile
Verify chat UI loads and real-time messaging works

title: Private Gallery Locked Status and Unlock via CMPX Tokens
description: Ensure the private gallery is initially blurred or locked and can be unlocked only after successful CMPX token payment.

steps.description: Open chat with a matched user who has private gallery content
Verify the private gallery is visually blurred or locked
Attempt to unlock private gallery by initiating token payment
Complete payment with sufficient CMPX token balance
Verify private gallery content is accessible and unblurred

title: Token Dashboard Displays Correct CMPX/GTK Balances
description: Verify that token balances and transaction information are correctly shown in the tokens dashboard for CMPX and GTK tokens.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /tokens
Verify CMPX and GTK token balances are displayed correctly
Verify recent transactions and token system navigation links are present and functional

title: Navigation Components Responsive Behavior Across Devices
description: Verify that top and bottom navigation menus function correctly with responsive layouts on mobile, tablet, and desktop screen sizes.

steps.description: Resize viewport or use device emulation to simulate mobile device
Verify navigation menu items are visible and accessible without obstruction
Resize viewport or emulate tablet device
Verify navigation adapts appropriately for tablet layout
Resize viewport or emulate desktop
Verify full navigation is visible and functional

title: Profile Viewing and Editing for Single Profile
description: Validate users can view detailed single profiles and access edit screens to modify profile data.

steps.description: Login and navigate to single profile page /profile-single
Verify profile details are rendered correctly
Navigate to edit profile screen /profile-single/edit
Update editable fields and save changes
Verify changes are persisted and displayed in profile detail

title: Profile Viewing and Editing for Couple Profile
description: Validate similar flows as single profile but for couple profiles with combined editable layout.

steps.description: Login and navigate to couple profile page /profile-couple
Verify couple profile details are displayed with appropriate layout
Navigate to edit couple profile /profile-couple/edit
Modify profile fields and save changes
Verify edited content is properly saved and reflected in the profile

title: View Verified Events Listings
description: Check that the Events page renders listings of verified events with accurate details.

steps.description: Access /events page
Verify event listings load and each item shows correct verified status, date, and venue info

title: View Verified Clubs Listings
description: Validate that the Clubs page presents a list of upcoming and verified clubs correctly.

steps.description: Access /clubs page
Verify club entries display verification badges and upcoming event information

title: Admin Access with Role Restrictions
description: Ensure that only users with the admin role can access admin dashboards and management screens, and unauthorized access is blocked.

steps.description: Login as non-admin user
Attempt to access /admin or other admin routes
Verify access denied or redirected to unauthorized page
Login as admin user
Access /admin dashboard and navigate various admin management screens
Verify full access to admin functionalities without error

title: Moderator Access with Role Restrictions
description: Verify that only users assigned moderator roles can access moderation pages and tools, and others are denied.

steps.description: Login as user without moderator permissions
Try to navigate to moderator routes under /moderators
Verify access is prevented with proper warning or redirect
Login as a user with moderator role
Access moderator dashboard and management tools
Verify functional and error-free moderator interface

title: AI Help Access from Control Center
description: Validate that AI help features and assistance can be accessed from the AI Control Center and provide relevant help content.

steps.description: Login and navigate to /ai-help or AI Control Center
Verify AI help UI loads correctly
Request common help topics or assistance
Verify appropriate help content or responses are displayed

title: Marketplace UI Rendering and Navigation
description: Ensure Marketplace, Shop, and NFTs screens render without UI crashes even when features are partially complete.

steps.description: Navigate to /marketplace page
Verify marketplace UI loads without visual or functional errors
Navigate to /shop page
Verify shop UI renders correctly without UI crashes
Navigate to /nfts page
Verify NFTs screen displays properly without errors

title: Legal and Info Pages Accessibility and Content
description: Verify that terms of service, privacy policy, Ley Olimpia, and support pages are accessible and display correct compliance information.

steps.description: Navigate to /terms page
Verify terms of service text and layout
Navigate to /privacy page
Verify privacy policy content is complete
Navigate to /ley-olimpia page
Verify legal compliance info regarding Ley Olimpia MX is present
Navigate to /support page
Verify user support information is displayed

title: Security Monitoring Triggers Alerts on Suspicious Activity
description: Check that the Security Monitor service detects suspicious login or account activity and triggers alerts/notifications.

steps.description: Perform multiple failed login attempts from the same IP address or suspicious location
Verify that security alert is logged and user receives security notification
Attempt login from unusual device or location after successful login
Verify system logs event and notifies user or admin as per security monitoring rules

title: Automated Test Suite Coverage Verification
description: Ensure that automated testing suites cover critical paths including authentication, discover/match/chat flows, gallery unlocks, and tokens with no regressions.

steps.description: Run unit tests on components for authentication, discover, chat, and tokens
Verify all unit tests pass without failures
Run integration tests for full user flows such as registration to chat
Verify integration tests cover expected behavior end-to-end
Execute e2e tests simulating real user interactions
Confirm no regressions or critical failures appear in e2e results
